title: Concept-Reversed Winograd Schema Challenge: Evaluating and Improving Robust Reasoning in Large Language Models via Abstraction
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating coreference resolution and robust reasoning by creating an adversarial dataset (CR-WSC) that reverses common semantic associations (stereotypes). While it includes an 'Ethics Statement' regarding dataset construction and the avoidance of reinforcing stereotypes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component.
